2. Apprehending their arrest, the applicants have approached this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail, in connection with Gamharia P.S. Case No. 110 of 2022, registered for the offence under Sections 498A/323/406 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3/ 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, pending in the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Seraikella.
3.
Learned counsel for the applicants seeks permission to withdraw the present application as the police has already submitted the final form.
5. Accordingly, the present anticipatory bail application is, hereby, dismissed as withdrawn.
